verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents its own opt-out: requests join the Model Improvement Program (MIP) by default, and setting mip_opt_out=true per request stops them from being retained. This covers data collection for model improvement, but the evidence says nothing about SDK, CLI or client telemetry or analytics tracking. The opt-out is also per request rather than an account-wide setting. Missing for 10: documented opt-out for SDK/CLI/client telemetry, an account-level or default opt-out setting, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Opt out per request with mip_opt_out=true. Opted-out requests are not retained
Requests participate in the Model Improvement Program (MIP) by default, and Deepgram retains them
